description: WTGs must be spaced in a 1-by-1-nmi offset grid pattern.
context_quote: SouthCoast Wind would space WTGs in a 1-by-1-nmi offset grid pattern (east–west-by-north–south- gridded layout).

description: Offshore export cables must be within a 1,640 – 2,300-foot wide corridor.
context_quote: From one (1) or more (no more than five (5)) OSPs within the lease area, up to six (6) offshore export cables (up to four (4) power cables and up to two (2) communications cables) within a single, 1,640 – 2,300-foot wide, offshore export cable corridor (OECC) will travel a total of 124 miles.

description: Six WTGs in the northeastern portion of the Lease Area must be eliminated to reduce impacts on Nantucket Shoals.
geographic_scope: Northeastern portion of the Lease Area
context_quote: However, six WTGs (AZ-47, BA-47, BB-47, BC-47, BF-48, and BF-49) would be eliminated in the northeastern portion of the Lease Area to reduce potential impacts on foraging habitat and potential displacement of wildlife from this habitat adjacent to Nantucket Shoals.

description: Sand bedform removal must not exceed more than 5% of the Falmouth export cable route.
context_quote: A description of how sand bedform removal will be limited to the extent required to achieve adequate cable burial depth and will not exceed more than 5% of the Falmouth export cable route.

description: Clearance zone for North Atlantic Right Whale during pile driving is 10,000 m for pin and 15,000 m for monopile.
context_quote: NARW PAM Clearance/ Shutdown Zone: 10,000 m (pin), 15,000 m (monopile)
